title: Input
description: Text field with label above, helper below, and an invalid state. Never placeholder-as-label

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label linked to the native input. An instance ID is generated unless id is supplied.

props.name: help
props.description: Helper content included in the input accessible description.

props.name: error
props.description: Error content included in the accessible description and invalid state; false, null and undefined omit it.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes on the field wrapper. className, ref and native input props target the input itself.
